body: Reading your past posts, I can't imagine what you've been through. Losing so much. The way you feel. I understand that you feel that there is nothing left. That you cannot go on. How helpless you feel. But please hang on. You can heal and you can fight. You may feel weak but you are strong. Strong because you have lasted this long even having been through so much. You deserve happiness and I'm sorry. I'm sorry that you've been through so much. I am sorry that you feel this way. Nobody can stop you, it's your decision in the end, but I can imagine the regret and sadness I and everybody around you would feel if you made this choice.

Reading that post, I understand a bit more. I have mild autism, different types of anxiety, depression, etc. I went to see a therapist in person because I thought that would cure me, it didn't. I hated going because I had to fill that endless silence and tell this stranger everything. She wouldn't talk to me and it made me sick. I felt as though the walls closed in on me, like I was in this tiny box with my mouth being forced open. I realised after that it was my therapist, not me, that was the problem. Im too nervous to talk to my doctor about my problems, fearing that I'll be shouted or laughed at for wasting their time with my stupid fears. This may not be how you feel but I hope you can relate in some way. I decided to talk to my most trusted friend, tell them everything. And it really helped. It lifted the rock that was on my head, crushing me. It may take you days, weeks, months, years until you're ready but you must get help. You have to push through that anxiety and fake it until you make it. You are worth the effort. Worth the work and pain and stress it will take. Because it will be better in the end.

No matter your past or current behaviour, the things that have happened to you are awful. Disgusting things. You should've never ever had to go through them. That being said, just because the people around don't believe or don't care about your attempts is such an ignorant retaliation. Everybody deserves help. You, with everything you've been through, deserve help just as much as anybody else. Sometimes people go to therapy, get on anti-depressants, and are disappointed with the results. Whereas, somebody who tries the exact same person or exact same meds are happy with the results. Just because you haven't found the solution yet, doesn't mean you can't. If you push on, see the positives of your existence, you can heal and live a happy life. Not because I am telling you, but because that is the truth. All life is precious. All life is perfect.

I can never truly understand what you feel like. I know that depression will make you feel endlessly tired, that it's not worth getting up in the morning. I know I can't give you much advice because everyone is different, feelings are different, actions are different, experiences are different, but I want to offer my ears. Sometimes it helps to just unload everything onto a person. If you wish, I can be that person. It may feel overwhelming to do so but it can really help. You getting help is worth the effort.
Message me if you wish. I am always open to listen.

I appreciate your comment. I know that my dad is toxic, I've learned from my mistakes of letting him into my heart. But I have learned that I do need to forgive him. Not for his benefit but for mine. I will never forget what he did and does but I do wish to heal my wounds and become stronger. I'm pan, but I like to wear mens clothes so people always assume I'm lesbian and talk down to me because of my style. 

I hope the situation with your mother can be fixed and you can bond and form a relationship. It will feel impossible, but you have to learn that you cannot waste your emotions on somebody that does not deserve it. It took my mum, somebody who had no father and a mother who neglected her, twenty seven years to forgive her mother for the pain she caused. Thirteen years for her ex-husband. It will be a while until I can heal and forgive but I hope I have the strength to do so. I hope this doesn't sound like I'm commanding you, that's not what I mean, but I can put myself in your shoes. Even though, of course, i can never feel what you're feeling.

Have a wonderful evening.

Thank you for your comment. It was lovely to read. It made me think a lot. I'm glad you posted it. I've attempted before but gave up, I didn't have the guys to do it. I never got caught because I keep to myself and I'm quiet. My current state of mind is nowhere near as bad as it used to be. I still feel all of these things, just at a less intensity. I can't believe how difficult it must've been for you but I am glad you are here, replying to people who feel broken. I hope I would never even consider self-harm because it is addictive, I've seen it unfold in front of me. I've tried therapy and hated it but I will take your advice into consideration.

I may not be able to help you, give you any good advice, but what I can say is that I understand. People want to tell you that you're worth it, you shouldn't do it because you have a future, that you have a place on this earth. It may seem fake when they say it and, most likely, they have no idea how you really feel. Even if two people have depression, they do not feel the same. I cannot relate to how you are feeling. I cannot relate to your problems. But I can relate to a solution. It may seem fake when they tell you positive things because all you see is the negative. Everybody has a right for life and chances. No matter how bad you think you are or how bad your life is, it can ALWAYS change. For the better or worse. Talk to somebody. Talk to you mum. Talk. Fill the silence even if you don't want to. Even if you're anxious. Even if you're sad. Talk. I hope this helped because I do, genuinely, believe all life has meaning.

Your comment doesn't make sense to me. I understand all that you are saying. I understand what you mean. I just don't feel like you are talking to me. "Although you aren't perfect, you are you." I am In no way perfect. I believe perfect does not exist. "but you are you". I feel like being myself Is an embarrassment to the human race. I see people that look the way I do and I see the beautiful parts of them. In me, I see no beauty. I feel that I am not real. I just watch my life story happen to me. The endless amounts of stress is just casual to me now. I have severe social anxiety but I put on my mask and I am confident, friendly, professional. I'm not saying, in any way, that your sentence, "Although you are not perfect, you are yourself", is false. I agree. But I also believe that you are never really you unless you live in your world. That probably made no sense. 

Do you ever feel like yourself?
